about: The secreta of the formulary “Mass of the First Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. This formulary serves the weekdays of that week. On the Sunday itself the feast of the Holy Family takes its place.

seg.tr: May the sacrifice offered unto Thee, O Lord, ever give us life and strengthen us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
